description: Test suite for media utility functions and media stream info classes in the starboard media namespace, including tests for audio/video stream info conversions and duration/frames calculations.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents audio stream information, including codec, mime type, channels, sample rate, and config data.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents video stream information, including codec, mime type, capabilities, resolution, and color metadata.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains audio stream info along with sample-specific data like codec, mime, channels, sample rate, and config.

classes.name: VideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains video stream info along with sample-specific data like key frame flag, resolution, and color metadata.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Converts raw data pointer and size into a std::vector<uint8_t>.

methods.name: AudioDurationToFrames
methods.description: Converts audio duration in microseconds to frame count based on sample rate.

methods.name: AudioFramesToDuration
methods.description: Converts frame count to duration in microseconds based on sample rate.
